# Portfolio Choice with Trading Frictions {#plan-ch20}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Planned
:::

Connects forecasts and desired positions to the costly, gradual process of moving an actual portfolio.

**Subtopics.** Signals and expected returns; turnover; transaction costs; signal decay; dynamic mean-variance control; no-trade regions; impulse and singular control; model-predictive rebalancing; robust portfolios; execution-aware portfolio construction; the boundary between portfolio and execution decisions.
